headline: NiziU drops first MV teaser for 'Jolly Jolly'
sub: New digital single and MV arrive Dec 2 at midnight JST
caption:
NiziU just dropped the first music video teaser for their new song 'Jolly Jolly'! 🎄

JYP Entertainment unveiled 'Jolly Jolly' M/V Teaser 1 on its official YouTube channel. The digital single and music video will be released on Dec 2 (Wed) at 12 AM JST (also 12 AM KST).

📌 Source: JYP Entertainment official YouTube
